summary.intent: Run the full GSD plan-phase workflow for Phase 62 ('Unified Node Codec Core Keystone') — research, planning, verification, and begin execution — covering the replacement of legacy metadata types with unified Node types, dual-sealed bodies, and generation-based AAD across the CipherBox monorepo.
summary.outcome: Planning fully completed (9 plans / 7 waves, 15/15 verification dimensions, 6/6 requirements, 9/9 decisions). Execution reached Wave 2 of 7: Wave 1 done (plans 62-01 and 62-03, 2/9 total), Wave 2 in flight (plan 62-02 spawned). Transcript ends mid-execution.

repo: Consumer test files referencing deleted types fail tsc BEFORE `describe.skip` evaluates — imports must be removed entirely, not just test bodies skipped.
Vault v3 blob layout: `0x03 | u16_BE(readLen) | ECIES(rootReadKey) | u16_BE(writeLen) | ECIES(rootWriteKey)` — removes `encryptedRootFolderKey`. Hard-cut: v1/v2 paths fully deleted.
Compile-gate dependency order is strict: core → sdk-core → sdk → web. Each phase plan enforces it as a wave boundary.
Cross-language parity vectors (vault-v3-blob.json, node-codec.json) must live in `tests/vectors/`, never inline in plan files — required by D-04 and Phase 69 Rust test slot.
Nyquist validation requires RESEARCH.md to contain a `## Validation Architecture` section; without it, the planner cannot produce VALIDATION.md and Dimension-8 requirements are missing.
Schema-gate (Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM/Payload/Supabase) does not apply to `registry/schema.ts` or `bin/types.ts` in packages/core — DB schema lives in apps/api (Phase 66 scope).
Phase 62 blast radius: ~30 consumer files in sdk-core, sdk, web require mechanical import-swap + stub, but no semantic logic changes in those packages.
The gsd commit helper has a known false-negative bug: it reports `commit_failed` even when the commit lands successfully; always verify with `git log` rather than retrying.

code.finding: New file created in Wave 1 (62-01): defines Node, SealedChildRef, PublishedNode, content/write-body types. Foundation for all codec work.
New file created in Wave 1 (62-01): JSON-body codec, round-trip for folder/file/root, generation range fail-closed, fileKey as Uint8Array.
Committed cross-language golden vector for vault v3 blob in Wave 1 (62-03). Used by Phase 69 Rust tests — must not be modified after freeze.
Frozen in Wave 2 (62-02): body-bytes primary lock (IV-independent) + fixed-key/fixed-IV full-seal lock. Reuses Phase-61 node_id/IV for Phase-69 Rust slot.

workflow: PATTERNS.md is not committed by step 13d of the plan-phase workflow — it must be committed explicitly after the pattern-mapper subagent completes (known gap).
Worktree isolation is skipped for sequential wave execution in pnpm monorepos: no node_modules per worktree means slow per-worktree `pnpm i`, and the cross-package dist chain is simpler on one tree.
API-surface intel regeneration returning 0 symbols means the file is HINT-only and should be omitted from the planner prompt to avoid noise.

`partial-tsc` verify steps must guard exit codes — trailing `echo` after `tsc` masks non-zero exits, causing false-green verifies. All verifies in Phase 62 plans were fixed to use explicit exit-code capture.

Plan size threshold (~43 files) triggered a split of Plan 08 into 08a (web logic, wave 6) and 08b (web components + final pnpm typecheck, wave 7) to reduce context exhaustion risk in autonomous execution.

The drift pre-check is non-blocking but can generate false positives (143 pre-existing elements flagged) when the baseline map is stale or missing — `/gsd-map-codebase` refreshes it but is not required to proceed.

friction: gsd commit helper false-negative: reports `commit_failed` for commits that actually land (e.g., VALIDATION.md commit `2475ae35d`). Required verifying via `git log` after every commit.
Bash node eval had a quoting bug during worktree-mode resolution, requiring a clean re-run to extract init data.
Requirements coverage display had a word-splitting glitch (all six NODE IDs printed as a single token) — a cosmetic bug that required a clean re-run to confirm true pass.
Plan checker returned 1 blocker + 4 warnings on first pass, requiring a full revision iteration (re-spawn of planner + re-check). Added latency for an otherwise well-specified phase.
Drift pre-check flagged 143 pre-existing elements unrelated to Phase 62 — noise that required manual inspection to confirm non-blocking.
